verses.text: On that day you will say: "I will thank you, LORD. Even though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away, and you comfort me.
Look, God is my salvation. I will trust him and not be afraid. For the LORD, yes the LORD, is my strength and my song. He has become my salvation."
With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
On that day you will say: "Thank the LORD! Call on his name! Tell the nations what he has done! Announce that his name is lifted high!
Sing to the LORD, for he has done wonderful things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Shout out loud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel among you is great!"
